title: EzuCensor
description:
EzuCensor is a free Paper 1.21+ Minecraft Plugin that creates a better environment with a family friendly chat protection plugin!
Features include: Customisable settings for the panel, ingame censor word configurations and many more!
body:
EzuCensor is a free Paper 1.21+ Minecraft Plugin that creates a better environment with a family friendly chat protection plugin!
Features include: Customisable settings for the panel, ingame censor word configurations and many more!

The main command is /ezucensor panel, which opens the EzuCensor panel which has everything you need!
